Mantle uses these as separate, dynamically-loaded libraries (WebAssembly / prebuilt native binaries) without modification; their LGPL terms are satisfied by this notice and by shipping them as replaceable, independently-licensed modules. Dual-licensed components (e.g. `jszip` MIT-or-GPL, `@zone-eu/mailsplit` MIT-or-EUPL) are used under their permissive (MIT) option.
